title: Descent of a comparison between two existing neighbourhood models
statement: Let S be a Noetherian quasi-separated scheme and c:C\to S a qcqs morphism locally of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let U,W\subseteq S be open, s\in W, and let P and R be finite etale covers of C_U=c^{-1}(U) and C_W=c^{-1}(W) respectively [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Put L=C\times_S Spec O_{S,s}, with projection j:L\to C [def-pc-fibre-product], and suppose l:L\to C_W satisfies l\circ i_W=j (composition read as l followed by i_W). Suppose the pullbacks of P and l^*R are isomorphic over C_U\times_C L. Then there exists an open V with s\in V\subseteq W such that P and R|_{C_V} have isomorphic restrictions to C_U\cap C_V. Here R|_{C_V} is the actual pullback of R along the inclusion C_V\to C_W; no new cover is constructed.

proof.text: Construct the affine-open neighbourhood diagram of s and its stalk cone. The universal property in lem-weil-pbc-local-ring-spec-limit-affine-neighbourhoods proves that cone limiting. Affine neighbourhoods inside W are nonempty and cofiltered by the affine-open basis; their inclusion in all affine neighbourhoods is initial. Whiskering therefore gives the same stalk limit for this restricted system. All definitions and cofinality proofs are actual Lean constructions in nhdsDiagram, nhdsCone, within_cofiltered and within_initial.

Construct overlapDiagram with stages C_U intersect C_V and inclusion transitions, and overlapCone with point C_U times_C (C times_S Spec O_S,s). Its projections are pullback lifts. The open fibre-product identification lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product is implemented by Mathlib isPullback_opens_inf. Paste with isPullback_morphismRestrict and the local fibre-product square to prove the cartesian cone-leg squares. Apply Mathlib isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected to the limiting neighbourhood cone. The same pasting and cancellation proves that overlap transitions are base changes of inclusions between affine neighbourhoods, hence affine. The proofs are in overlap_stage_square, overlapCone_limit and overlap_transition_affine. C is locally Noetherian by local finite type and compact by quasi-compactness of c over the Noetherian S; consequently C is Noetherian and all overlap opens are qcqs.

Pullback associativity converts the given iterated pullback of R to its pullback along the composite local-overlap projection followed by l. The equation hl identifies this composite with every cone projection followed by overlapRight; overlapCone_left gives the analogous compatibility for PA. Both finite etale covers have finitely presented structure maps and qcqs total spaces at any stage. The proved theorem AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_of_isPullback in the module of thm-pd-spreading-out descends the comparison and inverse equations by Tag 01ZM(2),(3). The helper finiteEtale_stageIso applies it to the two cartesian models, then lifts the resulting structure-compatible scheme isomorphism to the category of finite etale covers.

Return the resulting affine neighbourhood V, its recorded containment in W, and membership of s. The proved helper finiteEtaleCompIso identifies pullback along overlapRight with the iterated pullback along C.homOfLE inf_le_right and C.homOfLE (c.preimage_mono hVW), giving exactly the original conclusion. Empty overlaps cause no exception: all constructions use universal properties and finite-presentation descent with no nonemptiness assumption on the overlap.

theorem FiniteEtale.exists_neighbourhood_comparison_of_stalk {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation c]
    (U W : S.Opens) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale) (s : S) (hsW : s ∈ W)
    (R : (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (l : Limits.pullback c (S.fromSpecStalk s) ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme)
    (hl : l ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s))
    (e : Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback
      (pullback.fst (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s)))).obj PA ≅
      (FiniteEtale.pullback
      (pullback.snd (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s)))).obj
        ((FiniteEtale.pullback l).obj R))) :
    ∃ (V : S.Opens) (hVW : V ≤ W), s ∈ V ∧
      Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback
        (C.homOfLE (inf_le_left : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (c ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≤ c ⁻¹ᵁ U))).obj PA ≅
        (FiniteEtale.pullback
        (C.homOfLE (inf_le_right : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (c ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≤ c ⁻¹ᵁ V))).obj
          ((FiniteEtale.pullback (C.homOfLE (c.preimage_mono hVW))).obj R))
